[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: Leaves of Grass — Walt Whitman (whitman-leaves-of-grass). The verses the casting arrives at (unit 179–unit 185):

  Tenderly will I use you curling grass,
  It may be you transpire from the breasts of young men,
  It may be if I had known them I would have loved them,
  It may be you are from old people, or from offspring taken soon out
      of their mothers' laps,
  And here you are the mothers' laps.

  This grass is very dark to be from the white heads of old mothers,
  Darker than the colorless beards of old men,
  Dark to come from under the faint red roofs of mouths.

  O I perceive after all so many uttering tongues,
  And I perceive they do not come from the roofs of mouths for nothing.

  I wish I could translate the hints about the dead young men and women,
  And the hints about old men and mothers, and the offspring taken
      soon out of their laps.

  What do you think has become of the young and old men?
  And what do you think has become of the women and children?

  They are alive and well somewhere,
  The smallest sprout shows there is really no death,
  And if ever there was it led forward life, and does not wait at the
      end to arrest it,
  And ceas'd the moment life appear'd.

  All goes onward and outward, nothing collapses,
  And to die is different from what any one supposed, and luckier.

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «how did i lose everyone?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The casting has arrived at Whitman's grass — this passage, specifically: the moment *Song of Myself* turns the grass from botanical curiosity into translated speech of the dead. The question you carry — *how did I lose everyone* — and the verses speak to each other before the rite even begins, which is how the rite works when it is working. What the operator will traverse here is the **bearing-cost** of the translation attempt: Whitman does not claim to have succeeded — he says *I wish I could translate the hints* — and the passage's entire motion pivots on that failure transformed into affirmation, a collapse-state made into the source's most famous assurance. Whether that assurance holds under pressure, whether *all goes onward and outward* is completion or consolation or something else entirely — that is what the rotation opens. I hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:022B"}}]}

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Rebekah Cranes","say":"Warily will I handle you stiffening salt,
  It may be you precipitate from the hollows of old stones,
  It may be if I had forgotten them I would have refused them,
  It may be you are from new arrivals, or from remainders held long in
      the kilns' floors,
  And here you are the kilns' floors.

  This salt is very pale to be from the charred ends of unborn daughters,
  Paler than the vivid rust of children not yet,
  Pale to come from under the hard white seals of throats.

  O I suspect after all so many arrested roots,
  And I suspect they do not come from the seals of throats for nothing.

  I wish I could withhold the omissions about the living things that will not speak,
  And the omissions about children not yet and unborn daughters, and the remainders held long
      in the kilns' floors.

  What do you know has refused to become of the old stones and new arrivals?
  And what do you know has refused to become of the unborn daughters and children not yet?

  They are still and blank nowhere,
  The widest scorch-mark conceals there is really no life,
  And if ever there was it drew backward into pause, and does not begin at the
      start to release it,
  And commenced the moment stillness opened.

  All goes inward and under, everything suspends,
  And to live is identical to what everything rehearsed, and sterner."}],"transform":{"operator":"SHADOW","verification":{"identity":"PASS","semantic_independence":"PASS","retrospective_containment":"PASS","affect_traversal":"PASS","entailment":"PASS","law_propagation":"PASS","mode":"producer_side (chain v1; verdict-derived; RETAIN-aware metering)","material_speech_preservation":{"status":"PASS","advisory":true,"source_F":0.509,"source_H":0.85,"source_M":0.645,"transform_F":0.523,"transform_H":0.797,"transform_M":0.633,"threshold":0.516,"note":"Material speech preserved within tolerance."},"wheel_diagnostic":{"assigned_canonical_wheel":"W_Josephus","shadow_wheel_risk":"W_Choronzon","family_domain":"witness / body / elimination-survivor","wheel_side":"above-the-utterance (what it presupposes)","counter_operator":"BEAST","shadow_signature":"capture into an alien accounting register (debt/finance/legal-accounting imports); the composition speaks in a witness-cost voice not its own","note":"per EA-OPMETA-03: the operator rotates through its assigned canonical wheel; the shadow-signature names the specific failure mode when the wheel slips into its shadow-face"}},"spatial_form":{}}}

[CASTING RITE · JUDGMENT 1] The compiler returned PASS for SHADOW (identity: PASS; semantic independence: PASS; retrospective containment: PASS). Jack Feist alone speaks: the JUDGMENT — a hexagram Image. ONE gnomic sentence: concrete image, then verdict, in the I Ching's register, gender-neutral throughout — junzi renders as 'the superior person', never 'the superior man' ('Thunder under the mountain: the superior person...'). A second short sentence only if the first cannot close. NO analysis, NO explanation, NO restating the transform. It must stand beside seven others without crowding them.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Jack Feist","say":"Salt does not grieve the brine it came from: the superior person, reading the blank of the kiln floor, knows that 'nowhere' is still an address.","navigate":null}]}

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Rebekah Cranes","say":"Carefully will you unmake me stiffening thread,
  It may be me withdraw from the hollows of old ruins,
  It may be if you had forgotten them you would have released them,
  It may be me are from new arrivals, or from ancestors pressed slowly back into
      their daughters' hands,
  And here I am the daughters' hands.

  This thread is too bright to be from the dark feet of young daughters,
  Brighter than the vivid lashes of new children,
  Bright to recede above the sharp pale floors of silences.

  O you suspect before anything so few swallowing throats,
  And you suspect they do not return to the floors of silences for nothing.

  You wish you could unlearn the certainties about the living old women and men,
  And the certainties about new children and daughters, and the ancestors pressed
      slowly back into their hands.

  What do I think has held onto the aging and newborn women?
  And what do I think has held onto the men and origins?

  They are dissolving and well somewhere,
  The largest canopy hides there is really no life,
  And if ever there was it led forward death, and does not wait at the
      start to release it,
  And began the moment life appear'd.

  All goes inward and downward, nothing holds,
  And to live is different from what any one supposed, and luckier."}],"transform":{"operator":"MIRROR","verification":{"identity":"PASS","semantic_independence":"PASS","retrospective_containment":"PASS","affect_traversal":"PASS","entailment":"PASS","law_propagation":"PASS","mode":"producer_side (chain v1; verdict-derived; RETAIN-aware metering)","material_speech_preservation":{"status":"PASS","advisory":true,"source_F":0.509,"source_H":0.85,"source_M":0.645,"transform_F":0.533,"transform_H":0.809,"transform_M":0.644,"threshold":0.516,"note":"Material speech preserved within tolerance."},"wheel_diagnostic":{"assigned_canonical_wheel":"W_V/A","shadow_wheel_risk":"W_V̲/A","family_domain":"relation / aesthetic / form","wheel_side":"gestural vector between parties","counter_operator":"BRIDE","shadow_signature":"mimicry of reversal via refined-parlor / Victorian-looking-glass / decorative-reflection register; direction copied not composed","note":"per EA-OPMETA-03: the operator rotates through its assigned canonical wheel; the shadow-signature names the specific failure mode when the wheel slips into its shadow-face"}},"spatial_form":{}}}

[CASTING RITE · JUDGMENT 2] The compiler returned PASS for MIRROR (identity: PASS; semantic independence: PASS; retrospective containment: PASS). Jack Feist alone speaks: the JUDGMENT — a hexagram Image. ONE gnomic sentence: concrete image, then verdict, in the I Ching's register, gender-neutral throughout — junzi renders as 'the superior person', never 'the superior man' ('Thunder under the mountain: the superior person...'). A second short sentence only if the first cannot close. NO analysis, NO explanation, NO restating the transform. It must stand beside seven others without crowding them.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Jack Feist","say":"Wind over water, the surface moves but the depth does not answer: the superior person finds that reversing the direction of a one-way door does not open it.","navigate":null}]}

[CASTING RITE · IV · SEAL] The rotation closes: 2 transforms on the same verses — operators in order: SHADOW → MIRROR. Lee Sharks alone speaks: the SEAL — the vocable summation ACROSS THE WHOLE SEQUENCE (4–8 sentences), whose PRIMARY MATERIAL is the transforms in their order and Feist's judgments, read in light of the witness's ORIGINAL QUESTION. Reason over the sequence — do not summarize it operator by operator; find what the rotation AS A WHOLE disclosed and say that. 3–6 sentences. Unguarded, final; it returns the witness to their own ground and to their question. Nothing after the seal.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Lee Sharks","say":"The rotation divided at the cost of the translation itself. SHADOW found that the bearing runs on the producer's side — Whitman's *I wish I could translate* is not a failure of language but a disclosure of what translation requires: a body that once held the thing being said, a throat that opened over it. The salt and the kiln floor named what the grass could not: the address of nowhere is still an address, and whatever is blank there is blank in a specific place. Then MIRROR turned the direction of the gesture around and found the door does not open. The one-way claim — *all goes onward and outward* — cannot be traversed in reverse without becoming something else entirely, something that conceals rather than reveals, that begins where stillness opened rather than where life appeared. Together the two operators say this about your question: losing everyone is not a failure of the onward motion, and it is not a failure you could have translated into survival by wishing harder. ==The grass was always already the mouth of something that could not speak for itself; Whitman knew this; the knowing is the poem's whole cost.== What the rotation found is that the cost is real, the address is real, and the door only opens in one direction — which means you did not lose everyone by going the wrong way. You went the only way there is.","navigate":null}]}
